'''Hyperbatteries''' were immense pillar-like storage devices capable of storing and converting immense amounts of geothermal energy extracted from a [[Planet/Legends|planets]] core to usable energy.

A set of hyperbatties were used in a [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|hyperbaride synthesis plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. These hyperbatteries were set to overload by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Marci Sertim]] and destroyed the plant.
